keys.description: (k, m, n, ...) array-like The `k` keys to be sorted. The *last* key (e.g, the last row if `keys` is a 2D array) is the primary sort key. Each element of `keys` along the zeroth axis must be an array-like object of the same shape.
constraints: shape must match between elements of `keys`

axis.description: int, optional Axis to be indirectly sorted. By default, sort over the last axis of each sequence. Separate slices along `axis` sorted over independently; see last example.

output.description: ------- (m, n, ...) ndarray of ints Array of indices that sort the keys along the specified axis.
